form.title: Title
form.formatHint: Tiptap is the rich editor. Markdown / HTML use a plain textarea. Tip: a slug ending in .html (e.g. promo.html) serves the post as a bare HTML response with no theme chrome.
form.previewHint: Preview reflects your current draft, including unsaved edits. On the public site the active theme adds its header / footer / typography around this content.
form.tagsHint: Used to group posts on tag pages (e.g. /tag/tech).
form.noLayoutHint: Serve this post as bare HTML — no theme header, footer, or root layout. The body is returned as the entire response. Best paired with format: HTML when the body contains a full <!DOCTYPE html>…</html> document.

static.pick: Pick a .zip or one or more files
static.pickHint: Bundle assets must reference each other with relative paths only (no leading /). The zip's contents are extracted into a directory under your post slug and served verbatim — no theme chrome.
static.issuesHint: Fix the listed paths and re-upload. Absolute (/foo) and protocol-relative (//cdn.example/foo) references break under the bundle's URL prefix.
static.emptyBundle: No usable files found in the selection.
static.previewHint: Static bundles render as the served HTML at /<slug>/. Preview by saving and visiting the public URL.

form.publishedAtHint: When the post goes live. Leave empty to use the current time when publishing. A future time schedules the post.

mediaPicker.title: Insert image
mediaPicker.description: Pick from your media library or upload a new file.
mediaPicker.emptyHint: Click {action} to add the first image.

list.title: Sites
list.description: Per-site settings stored in DynamoDB. Adding sites and binding domains is done in cms.config.ts.

edit.saved: Saved. The public site refreshes within ~1 minute (S3 cache + Next.js fetch cache).

list.title: Users
list.description: Promote signed-up users to admin or editor. Sign-ups always start with no role and must be granted access here.
list.cannotEditSelf: You cannot change your own role.

theme.title: Theme
theme.switched: Switched to {theme}. Public site refreshes within ~10 seconds (S3 cache rebuild).
theme.previewHint: Live preview of the selected theme using the public site. Reflects values currently saved in S3 — Save first to preview unsaved manifest edits.
theme.saved: Saved. Public site refreshes within ~10 seconds (S3 cache rebuild).
theme.invalidValues: One or more values are invalid — fix highlighted fields and try again.
theme.customizationHint: Empty input resets to the manifest default.

colorScheme.label: Color scheme
colorScheme.hint: How the public site picks between the theme's light and dark token palettes.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to manage your site.

signUp.title: Create admin account
signUp.description: The first user becomes the site admin.

confirm.title: Confirm email
confirm.description: Enter the verification code sent to your email.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.description: We'll email you a verification code.
forgot.codeSent: Verification code sent. Check your email.

reset.title: Set new password
reset.description: Enter the code from your email and a new password.

errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists.

plugins.title: Plugin Settings
plugins.description: Edit admin-managed values for installed plugins. Changes propagate to the public site within ~10 seconds (S3 cache rebuild).
plugins.noConfigurablePlugins: No installed plugins expose configurable settings.
plugins.saved: Saved. Public site refreshes within ~10 seconds.
plugins.invalidValue: One or more values are invalid — fix highlighted fields and try again.
plugins.resetDone: Stored value cleared. Falling back to the manifest default.

mcpTokens.title: MCP tokens
mcpTokens.description: Access tokens for the HTTP MCP endpoint. Use them in Claude Desktop / Cursor / any MCP-aware client to read and write this CMS over the wire.
mcpTokens.endpointMissing: Not deployed yet. Run `npm run sandbox` or push to Amplify Hosting to provision the endpoint URL.
mcpTokens.revealHint: This is the only time you will see this token. Copy it now — closing this dialog discards it permanently.
mcpTokens.listEmpty: No tokens yet. Click 'Create token' to issue your first one.
mcpTokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke this token? This cannot be undone.
